links.surface: عثمان ابن محمد ابن أبي شيبة

notes: two versions of the chain field (before the «|») meet at «ربيعة ابنة عياض», written twice, so separate offsets; «جدتي» and «جدي» are relation words followed by a name, so only the names are kept (rule 1); «سمعته أنا من» is the compiler's own wording and «أنا» is not a name; «سمعت جدي عبيدة ابن عمرو الكلابي» is written once and is shared by both routes (rule 5); the matn begins at «رأيت رسول الله»
